description.value: The Gull Bar & Kitchen is a family-owned gathering spot in North Vancouver's Shipyards District, serving scratch-made seasonal cuisine with ingredients sourced primarily from local BC farms and producers. The bar program leans into craft-brewery beers, old- and new-world wines, and cocktails made with fresh juices. It bills itself as a neighbourhood hub with weekly events like Tuesday Trivia and Wednesday Burger Night.
